  marker_colours: !r c(DNA1 = "blue", GD2 = "green", CD45 = "magenta", CD3 = "red", CD14 = "cyan", CD15 = "yellow")

  merge_exclude: !r character(0)

  # one column per marker). inv_cluster = "" skips the section.
  inv_col: "pg_raw_k15"          # k = 15 phenograph clusters BEFORE the GMM split
  inv_cluster: "39"
  inv_timepoint: "REL"
  inv_n_cells: 10
  inv_halfwidth: 15              # zoom window = (2 * 15 + 1) px square around the cell centroid (1 px = 1 um)
  inv_markers: !r c("DNA1_Ir193_mean", "GD2_Gd155_mean", "MPO", "CD56", "GATA3", "CD15_Bi209_mean")
  inv_marker_colours: !r c(DNA1 = "blue", GD2 = "green", MPO = "magenta", CD56 = "red", GATA3 = "cyan", CD15 = "yellow")

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Output directory for plots
plot_dir <- file.path(params$output, "plots/07_generate_images")
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

date_prefix <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

# Save a plot to plot_dir (dispatches on plot type). `filename` may carry a
# relative subfolder (e.g. "<image_id>/no_mask/x.png"); it is created if needed
# and the date prefix goes on the file name only.
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  out_dir   <- file.path(plot_dir, dirname(filename))
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  full_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(date_prefix, "_", basename(filename)))

  if (inherits(plot_obj, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(full_path, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  } else if (inherits(plot_obj, c("Heatmap", "HeatmapList"))) {
    pdf(full_path, width = width, height = height)
    draw(plot_obj)
    dev.off()
  } else {
    dev.copy(png, full_path, width = width * dpi, height = height * dpi, res = dpi)
    dev.off()
  }
  message("Saved: ", full_path)
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, error = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  dev = "png", dpi = 150, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8
)
```

# Region and marker images

This standalone report renders each requested bone-marrow (BM) image — as the
**whole image** and, when a zoom window is given, a **zoomed region**:

* each requested **marker** as a separate pixel image,
* a colour **merge** of all requested markers,
* the **cell types**, and
* the **metaclusters**.

BM samples are cytospins, so the tumor-compartment and cellular-neighborhood
panels of MapMetSC's `08_generate_images.Rmd` do not apply here. Plots are
grouped per image in `plots/07_generate_images/<image_id>/`, with three
subfolders:

* `no_mask/` — all panels above, pixel images unmasked;
* `masks/` — the marker images and the merge restricted to the segmentation
  mask (the same mask the cell-type panel is drawn on): signal is kept only
  inside cells, everything else is black, and the mask outline is drawn as a
  1 px white border just *outside* the cells;
* `mask_no_border/` — the same masked images without the white border.

The cell-level panels (cell types, metaclusters) are drawn on the segmentation
**masks** (`plotCells`), not as points. It is meant to be rendered from
`run_analysis.R` with a *customised* parameter list (image ids, zoom crops,
marker list) rather than the shared `main_params` — see the
`render_step("analysis/07_generate_images.Rmd", ...)` call there. Cell types and
colours are read from `spe_04_phenotyping.rds`, so the chosen images must be
among the BM images processed in [chapter 04](04_phenotyping.html).

## Load libraries
```{r load-libraries}
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(cytomapper)
library(cowplot)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load data and images
```{r load-data}
spe <- readRDS(file.path(params$output, "spe_04_phenotyping.rds"))

# Images to render + optional crops; vector image_ids/crops win over single image_id/crop.
image_ids <- if (!is.null(params$image_ids)) params$image_ids else params$image_id
if (is.null(image_ids) || !length(image_ids))
  stop("No image id provided: set params$image_ids (or params$image_id).")
crops <- if (!is.null(params$crops)) params$crops else
         if (!is.null(params$crop)) rep(list(params$crop), length(image_ids)) else
         vector("list", length(image_ids))          # all NULL -> whole image only
if (length(crops) != length(image_ids))
  stop("params$crops must have one entry per image id (NULL = whole image only). ",
       "Got ", length(crops), " crop(s) for ", length(image_ids), " id(s).")

missing_ids <- setdiff(image_ids, unique(as.character(spe$sample_id)))
if (length(missing_ids))
  stop("image id(s) not among the BM images in spe_04_phenotyping.rds: ",
       paste(missing_ids, collapse = ", "), ". Available images include: ",
       paste(head(unique(as.character(spe$sample_id))), collapse = ", "), " ...")

# Channel (_mean) marker names; requests resolve against these.
marker_names <- rownames(spe)[grepl("_mean$", rownames(spe))]

# Accept either a full channel name or a short marker name (token before "_").
resolve_markers <- function(requested, channels) {
  token <- sub("_.*$", "", channels)
  vapply(requested, function(r) {
    if (r %in% channels) return(r)
    hit <- channels[token == r]
    if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))
}

markers_full <- resolve_markers(params$markers, marker_names)
if (anyNA(markers_full))
  warning("Markers not found among the spe channels (dropped): ",
          paste(params$markers[is.na(markers_full)], collapse = ", "))
markers <- unname(markers_full[!is.na(markers_full)])
if (!length(markers)) stop("None of the requested markers match the spe channels.")
message("Rendering markers: ", paste(markers, collapse = ", "))

# Load one image + its mask + matching cells (tmp); channels named from marker_names.
load_image <- function(image_id) {
  tmp   <- spe[, spe$sample_id == image_id]
  img   <- loadImages(file.path(params$input, "img",   paste0(image_id, ".tif")))
  masks <- loadImages(file.path(params$input, "masks", paste0(image_id, ".tif")), as.is = TRUE)
  mcols(img)   <- DataFrame(sample_id = names(img))
  mcols(masks) <- DataFrame(sample_id = names(masks))
  message("Loaded '", image_id, "': image ", dim(img[[1]])[1], " x ", dim(img[[1]])[2],
          " px (", dim(img[[1]])[3], " channels); mask ",
          dim(masks[[1]])[1], " x ", dim(masks[[1]])[2], " px.")
  n_ch <- dim(img[[1]])[3]
  channelNames(img) <- if (n_ch <= length(marker_names)) {
    marker_names[seq_len(n_ch)]
  } else {
    c(marker_names, paste0("extra_channel_", seq_len(n_ch - length(marker_names))))
  }
  list(img = img, masks = masks, tmp = tmp)
}
```

## Colours and helpers
```{r helpers}
# Clamp/shift a requested [lo, hi] window to fit inside [1, n].
.clamp_axis <- function(lo, hi, n) {
  lo <- as.integer(round(lo)); hi <- as.integer(round(hi))
  if (lo > hi) { tmp <- lo; lo <- hi; hi <- tmp }
  w <- hi - lo
  if (w >= n - 1L) return(c(1L, n))
  lo <- max(1L, min(lo, n - w))
  c(lo, lo + w)
}

# Crop a CytoImageList to c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax). Rebuild each frame as an
# EBImage Image - plain `[` subsetting can drop the class and render black.
crop_cil <- function(cil, crop) {
  d0 <- dim(cil[[1]])
  xr <- .clamp_axis(crop[1], crop[2], d0[1])
  yr <- .clamp_axis(crop[3], crop[4], d0[2])
  if (!identical(c(xr, yr), as.integer(c(crop[1], crop[2], crop[3], crop[4]))))
    message("Crop x[", crop[1], "-", crop[2], "] y[", crop[3], "-", crop[4],
            "] adjusted to x[", xr[1], "-", xr[2], "] y[", yr[1], "-", yr[2],
            "] to fit the ", d0[1], " x ", d0[2], " px image.")
  xs <- seq(xr[1], xr[2]); ys <- seq(yr[1], yr[2])
  imgs <- lapply(seq_along(cil), function(i) {
    im  <- cil[[i]]
    dat <- EBImage::imageData(im)
    sub <- if (length(dim(im)) == 3L) dat[xs, ys, , drop = FALSE]
           else                       dat[xs, ys,    drop = FALSE]
    EBImage::Image(sub, colormode = EBImage::colorMode(im))
  })
  out <- CytoImageList(imgs)
  names(out) <- names(cil)
  mcols(out) <- mcols(cil)
  if (!is.null(channelNames(cil))) channelNames(out) <- channelNames(cil)
  out
}

# Rotate a CytoImageList 90 degrees counter-clockwise (transpose + flip, lossless
# for integer mask labels), as in MapMetSC (matches its plotSpatial orientation).
rotate90_ccw <- function(cil) {
  out <- CytoImageList(lapply(seq_along(cil), function(i)
    EBImage::flip(EBImage::transpose(cil[[i]]))))
  names(out) <- names(cil)
  mcols(out) <- mcols(cil)
  if (!is.null(channelNames(cil))) channelNames(out) <- channelNames(cil)
  out
}

# Scale bar (IMC pixel = 1 um), drawn only on the merge panel.
scale_bar_spec <- list(length = 100, label = "100 µm", cex = 1.5)

# Evaluate a plot call, then save + show it (TRUE), or report and skip on error
# (FALSE) so one bad panel - e.g. a flat channel - never aborts the render.
# plot_call is a promise, so plotting happens inside the tryCatch.
render_and_save <- function(plot_call, filename, width, height) {
  po <- tryCatch(plot_call,
                 error = function(e) {
                   message("Skipped ", filename, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
                 })
  if (is.null(po)) return(invisible(FALSE))
  p <- ggdraw(po$plot)
  save_plot(p, filename, width = width, height = height)
  print(p)
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# Per-marker colour (individual + merge), keyed by short name; unmapped get spare hues.
.marker_col_map <- local({
  fallback <- c("white", "orange", "yellow", "magenta", "pink", "brown")
  tok  <- sub("_.*$", "", markers)
  cols <- unname(params$marker_colours[tok])   # NA where the short name is unmapped
  miss <- which(is.na(cols))
  if (length(miss))
    cols[miss] <- fallback[((seq_along(miss) - 1) %% length(fallback)) + 1]
  setNames(cols, markers)
})

# Markers to draw individually but leave out of the merge (via params$merge_exclude).
.merge_exclude <- markers[sub("_.*$", "", markers) %in% params$merge_exclude]

# 1 px border just outside the foreground: background pixels that touch a
# foreground pixel (8-neighbourhood).
.outer_border <- function(fg) {
  nx <- nrow(fg); ny <- ncol(fg)
  pad <- matrix(FALSE, nx + 2, ny + 2)
  pad[2:(nx + 1), 2:(ny + 1)] <- fg
  dil <- fg
  for (dx in -1:1) for (dy in -1:1)
    dil <- dil | pad[(2:(nx + 1)) + dx, (2:(ny + 1)) + dy]
  dil & !fg
}

# Masked colour composite of markers `ms`, returned as a 3-channel (R, G, B)
# CytoImageList. Each marker is min-max scaled on the UNMASKED image (as
# plotPixels does for the no_mask panels, so brightness matches), coloured
# black -> its colour, summed and clipped to [0, 1]; pixels outside the cell
# mask (label 0) are set to 0 and, if `border`, the outer mask border to white.
masked_rgb <- function(img_v, masks_v, ms, border = TRUE) {
  dat <- EBImage::imageData(img_v[[1]])
  fg  <- EBImage::imageData(masks_v[[1]]) > 0
  if (!identical(dim(fg), dim(dat)[1:2]))
    stop("mask (", paste(dim(fg), collapse = " x "), ") and image (",
         paste(dim(dat)[1:2], collapse = " x "), ") sizes differ")
  if (!any(fg)) stop("no cells in the mask")
  rgb <- array(0, dim = c(dim(fg), 3))
  for (m in ms) {
    ch  <- dat[, , which(channelNames(img_v) == m)[1]]
    rng <- range(ch, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!(diff(rng) > 0)) stop("flat channel ", m)
    v   <- (ch - rng[1]) / diff(rng) * fg
    col <- grDevices::col2rgb(.marker_col_map[[m]])[, 1] / 255
    for (k in 1:3) rgb[, , k] <- rgb[, , k] + v * col[k]
  }
  rgb <- pmin(rgb, 1)
  if (border) {
    bd <- .outer_border(fg)
    for (k in 1:3) { ch <- rgb[, , k]; ch[bd] <- 1; rgb[, , k] <- ch }
  }
  out <- CytoImageList(list(EBImage::Image(rgb)))
  names(out) <- names(img_v)
  mcols(out) <- mcols(img_v)
  channelNames(out) <- c("R", "G", "B")
  out
}

# Draw a masked_rgb() composite with plotPixels (same orientation / scale bar
# as the no_mask panels). The composite is already in [0, 1], so scale = FALSE
# keeps plotPixels from re-stretching each R/G/B channel to its own max.
plot_masked <- function(img_v, masks_v, ms, scale_bar = NULL, border = TRUE) {
  rgb_cil <- masked_rgb(img_v, masks_v, ms, border = border)
  plotPixels(rgb_cil, colour_by = c("R", "G", "B"),
             colour = list(R = c("black", "red"), G = c("black", "green"),
                           B = c("black", "blue")),
             bcg = list(R = c(0, 1, 1), G = c(0, 1, 1), B = c(0, 1, 1)),
             scale = FALSE, image_title = NULL, scale_bar = scale_bar,
             legend = NULL, return_plot = TRUE)
}

# Render every panel (individual markers, merge, celltype, metacluster) for
# one view into <out_dir>/no_mask, plus the masked marker
# and merge images into <out_dir>/masks (white outer border) and
# <out_dir>/mask_no_border; tag goes into the filename. No legends.
plot_region <- function(img_v, masks_v, tmp, markers, tag, out_dir) {
  nm_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "no_mask")
  mk_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "masks")
  nb_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "mask_no_border")

  # --- individual markers, each in its assigned colour; keep the ones that render ---
  usable <- character(0)
  for (m in markers) {
    ok <- render_and_save(
      plotPixels(img_v, colour_by = m,
                 colour = setNames(list(c("black", .marker_col_map[[m]])), m),
                 bcg = setNames(list(c(0, 1, 1)), m),
                 image_title = NULL, scale_bar = NULL,
                 legend = NULL, return_plot = TRUE),
      file.path(nm_dir, paste0(tag, "_marker_", m, ".png")), 8, 8)
    if (isTRUE(ok)) {
      usable <- c(usable, m)
      render_and_save(plot_masked(img_v, masks_v, m),
                      file.path(mk_dir, paste0(tag, "_marker_", m, "_masked.png")), 8, 8)
      render_and_save(plot_masked(img_v, masks_v, m, border = FALSE),
                      file.path(nb_dir, paste0(tag, "_marker_", m, "_masked_no_border.png")), 8, 8)
    }
  }

  # --- merge of the rendered markers, minus the individual-only ones; scale bar
  #     here only. plotPixels shows at most 6 markers, so cap the merge at 6. ---
  merge_markers <- setdiff(usable, .merge_exclude)
  if (length(merge_markers) > 6) {
    message("Merge capped at 6 markers (cytomapper::plotPixels max); leaving out: ",
            paste(sub("_.*$", "", merge_markers[-seq_len(6)]), collapse = ", "))
    merge_markers <- merge_markers[seq_len(6)]
  }
  if (length(merge_markers)) {
    colour_list <- setNames(lapply(merge_markers, function(mm) c("black", .marker_col_map[[mm]])), merge_markers)
    bcg_list    <- setNames(lapply(merge_markers, function(x) c(0, 1, 1)), merge_markers)
    render_and_save(
      plotPixels(img_v, colour_by = merge_markers, colour = colour_list,
                 bcg = bcg_list, image_title = NULL, scale_bar = scale_bar_spec,
                 legend = NULL, return_plot = TRUE),
      file.path(nm_dir, paste0(tag, "_markers_merge.png")), 8, 8)
    render_and_save(plot_masked(img_v, masks_v, merge_markers, scale_bar = scale_bar_spec),
                    file.path(mk_dir, paste0(tag, "_markers_merge_masked.png")), 8, 8)
    render_and_save(plot_masked(img_v, masks_v, merge_markers, scale_bar = scale_bar_spec,
                                border = FALSE),
                    file.path(nb_dir, paste0(tag, "_markers_merge_masked_no_border.png")), 8, 8)
  }

  # --- cell types (on the masks) ---
  render_and_save(
    plotCells(masks_v, object = tmp, cell_id = "ObjectNumber", img_id = "sample_id",
              colour_by = "celltype",
              colour = list(celltype = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_celltype),
              missing_colour = "white", image_title = NULL, scale_bar = NULL,
              legend = NULL, return_plot = TRUE),
    file.path(nm_dir, paste0(tag, "_celltype.png")), 10, 8)

  # --- metaclusters (on the masks) ---
  render_and_save(
    plotCells(masks_v, object = tmp, cell_id = "ObjectNumber", img_id = "sample_id",
              colour_by = "metacluster",
              colour = list(metacluster = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_metacluster),
              missing_colour = "white", image_title = NULL, scale_bar = NULL,
              legend = NULL, return_plot = TRUE),
    file.path(nm_dir, paste0(tag, "_metacluster.png")), 10, 8)
}
```

## Whole image and zoom
Every image in `image_ids` is rendered as a whole image; when that image has a
zoom window in `crops`, the zoomed region is rendered too. Every output filename
carries the image id and `_whole` / `_zoom`, and is written under
`<image_id>/no_mask/`, `<image_id>/masks/` or `<image_id>/mask_no_border/`.

```{r generate}
for (i in seq_along(image_ids)) {
  image_id <- image_ids[[i]]
  crop     <- crops[[i]]
  message("=== image: ", image_id, " (", i, "/", length(image_ids), ") ===")

  loaded <- load_image(image_id)
  img <- loaded$img; masks <- loaded$masks; tmp <- loaded$tmp

  # Always the whole image; add the zoom when this image has crop coordinates.
  views <- list(whole = NULL)
  if (!is.null(crop)) views[["zoom"]] <- crop

  for (vn in names(views)) {
    cr      <- views[[vn]]
    # Crop in native orientation (crop coords stay in raw-image space), then rotate.
    img_v   <- if (is.null(cr)) img   else crop_cil(img,   cr)
    masks_v <- if (is.null(cr)) masks else crop_cil(masks, cr)
    img_v   <- rotate90_ccw(img_v)
    masks_v <- rotate90_ccw(masks_v)
    message("=== view: ", vn, " (", paste(dim(img_v[[1]])[1:2], collapse = " x "), " px) ===")
    plot_region(img_v, masks_v, tmp, markers, paste0(image_id, "_", vn), out_dir = image_id)
  }
}
```

## Cluster investigation

The ROI (image) of the `r params$inv_timepoint` samples with the most cells of cluster **`r params$inv_cluster`** of `r params$inv_col` (`pg_raw_k15` = the k = 15 phenograph clusters before the GMM split) is rendered like the images above, with the markers `r paste(sub("_.*$", "", params$inv_markers), collapse = ", ")`, plus a panel marking the cells of that cluster (red; the zoomed cells in yellow). Then `r params$inv_n_cells` random cells of the cluster in that ROI are zoomed individually (`r 2 * params$inv_halfwidth + 1` x `r 2 * params$inv_halfwidth + 1` px around the cell centroid, same orientation as the images) in one collage: one row per cell, one column per marker. Each marker is scaled black -> its colour from 0 to its 99.9th percentile in the whole ROI, so the intensities can be compared between cells; the grey outline marks the zoomed cell's mask. Output: `plots/07_generate_images/cluster_<cluster>_<timepoint>/`.

```{r cluster-investigation, eval = nzchar(params$inv_cluster), fig.width = 8, fig.height = 14}
stopifnot(params$inv_col %in% colnames(colData(spe)))
inv_lab  <- as.character(colData(spe)[[params$inv_col]])
in_cl    <- inv_lab == params$inv_cluster & spe$timepoint == params$inv_timepoint
roi_tab  <- sort(table(as.character(spe$sample_id[in_cl])), decreasing = TRUE)
if (!length(roi_tab)) stop("No cell of cluster ", params$inv_cluster, " in ", params$inv_timepoint, " samples.")
roi_n    <- table(as.character(spe$sample_id))[names(roi_tab)]
knitr::kable(head(data.frame(ROI = names(roi_tab), fm_id = spe$fm_id[match(names(roi_tab), spe$sample_id)],
                             cells_in_cluster = as.integer(roi_tab), cells_in_ROI = as.integer(roi_n),
                             pct = round(100 * as.integer(roi_tab) / as.integer(roi_n), 1)), 10),
             caption = paste0("ROIs of ", params$inv_timepoint, " samples with the most cells of cluster ", params$inv_cluster))
inv_roi <- names(roi_tab)[1]
inv_dir <- paste0("cluster_", params$inv_cluster, "_", params$inv_timepoint)
message("Cluster investigation: ROI ", inv_roi, " (", roi_tab[[1]], " cells of cluster ", params$inv_cluster, ")")

# markers / colours for this section
inv_markers <- unname(resolve_markers(params$inv_markers, marker_names))
if (anyNA(inv_markers)) warning("Investigation markers not found (dropped): ",
                                paste(params$inv_markers[is.na(inv_markers)], collapse = ", "))
inv_markers <- inv_markers[!is.na(inv_markers)]
inv_cols <- setNames(unname(params$inv_marker_colours[sub("_.*$", "", inv_markers)]), inv_markers)
inv_cols[is.na(inv_cols)] <- "white"
.marker_col_map <- c(inv_cols, .marker_col_map[setdiff(names(.marker_col_map), inv_markers)])

loaded <- load_image(inv_roi)
tmp    <- loaded$tmp
tmp_lab <- as.character(colData(tmp)[[params$inv_col]])

# random cells of the cluster in this ROI
set.seed(20261111)
cand <- tmp$ObjectNumber[tmp_lab == params$inv_cluster]
sel  <- if (length(cand) > params$inv_n_cells) sort(sample(cand, params$inv_n_cells)) else sort(cand)

# --- whole ROI: markers, merge, cell types, metaclusters + the cluster's cells ---
img_v   <- rotate90_ccw(loaded$img)
masks_v <- rotate90_ccw(loaded$masks)
plot_region(img_v, masks_v, tmp, inv_markers, paste0(inv_roi, "_whole"), out_dir = inv_dir)
tmp$inv_highlight <- ifelse(tmp$ObjectNumber %in% sel, "zoomed cells",
                            ifelse(tmp_lab == params$inv_cluster, paste("cluster", params$inv_cluster), "other"))
render_and_save(
  plotCells(masks_v, object = tmp, cell_id = "ObjectNumber", img_id = "sample_id",
            colour_by = "inv_highlight",
            colour = list(inv_highlight = setNames(c("yellow", "red", "grey30"),
                                                   c("zoomed cells", paste("cluster", params$inv_cluster), "other"))),
            missing_colour = "white", image_title = NULL, scale_bar = scale_bar_spec,
            return_plot = TRUE),
  file.path(inv_dir, "no_mask", paste0(inv_roi, "_whole_cluster_", params$inv_cluster, "_cells.png")), 10, 8)

# --- collage: one row per selected cell, one column per marker ---
dat  <- EBImage::imageData(loaded$img[[1]])
mk   <- EBImage::imageData(loaded$masks[[1]])
hw   <- params$inv_halfwidth
tiles <- list()
for (obj in sel) {
  pix <- which(mk == obj, arr.ind = TRUE)
  cx <- round(mean(pix[, 1])); cy <- round(mean(pix[, 2]))
  xr <- .clamp_axis(cx - hw, cx + hw, dim(mk)[1]); yr <- .clamp_axis(cy - hw, cy + hw, dim(mk)[2])
  xs <- seq(xr[1], xr[2]); ys <- seq(yr[1], yr[2])
  # same orientation as the images (rotate 90 degrees counter-clockwise)
  rot <- function(m) EBImage::imageData(EBImage::flip(EBImage::transpose(EBImage::Image(m))))
  border <- rot(.outer_border(mk[xs, ys] == obj))
  for (m in inv_markers) {
    ch  <- dat[, , which(channelNames(loaded$img) == m)[1]]
    hi  <- stats::quantile(ch, 0.999, names = FALSE); if (!(hi > 0)) hi <- max(ch, 1e-9)
    v   <- rot(pmin(ch[xs, ys] / hi, 1))
    rgbc <- grDevices::col2rgb(inv_cols[[m]])[, 1] / 255
    hex  <- grDevices::rgb(v * rgbc[1], v * rgbc[2], v * rgbc[3])
    hex[border] <- "#9E9E9E"
    tiles[[length(tiles) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      x = as.vector(row(v)), y = -as.vector(col(v)), fill = hex,
      cell = paste0("cell ", obj), marker = sub("_.*$", "", m))
  }
}
tiles <- do.call(rbind, tiles)
tiles$cell   <- factor(tiles$cell, levels = paste0("cell ", sel))
tiles$marker <- factor(tiles$marker, levels = sub("_.*$", "", inv_markers))
p_collage <- ggplot(tiles, aes(x, y, fill = fill)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  facet_grid(cell ~ marker, switch = "y") +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = paste0(inv_roi, ": cluster ", params$inv_cluster, " (", params$inv_col, "), ",
                      length(sel), " random cells")) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9), strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"), plot.title = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
p_collage
save_plot(p_collage, file.path(inv_dir, paste0(inv_roi, "_cluster_", params$inv_cluster, "_cells_collage.png")),
          width = 1.2 * length(inv_markers) + 1.2, height = 1.2 * length(sel) + 0.6)
```
